bugs.what: Elder's 'ask elder: what proof he wants' dialogue option stays in the menu after being asked once, unlike every other NPC's one-time dialogue lines (reeve, innkeep, scholar, smith, priest) which vanish after use.

confusions: The opening and notice board stress urgency ('crops fail, roads empty, it kills slow') but nothing over 77 turns of exploring, backtracking, and fetch-questing ever signaled the blight worsening or any turn pressure — unclear if turns matter before an ending.

On first entering the throne room, the game says 'Sealed or not, the doors were settled at the gate, with the reeve — not here' before the player has made any promise to the reeve, which briefly reads as the choice already being locked in.
suggestions: Make the elder's 'what proof he wants' prompt one-time like other NPCs, or otherwise mark which dialogue options are meant to be re-askable.
Give some periodic signal (even just flavor text) of the blight actually progressing, to back up the story's urgency.
Skill checks that fail (e.g. the strongbox lock) explicitly promise eventual success ('keep working the lock and it will open') with no cost to retrying — removes tension from those puzzles.
Combat encountered (ash wolf, barrow-wight) was trivial with a Scout build; consider a real combat/risk beat between collecting the verses+crown and reaching the throne.
